references.text: Describes the priests' share of the peace offerings, including the breast and the right thigh, which supplements the regulations in Deuteronomy regarding the rights of the priests.
Refers to the wave breast and the heave thigh as the priest's portion of the sacrifice, parallel to the parts mentioned in Deuteronomy.
Concerns the share of the offerings and firstfruits for the priests and Levites, which relates to the rights of the priests described in Deuteronomy.
Describes how Eli's sons abused their position by taking more than their rightful portion of the sacrificial meat, contrary to the lawful regulations.
Ezekiel describes the priests' share of offerings and firstfruits in the future temple, which is based on Old Testament statutes.
Paul refers to the principle that those who serve at the altar receive their share from the offering, applying this to preachers of the gospel.
